text:
Sara K: FYI we have a joint-deal demo with NimbleCloud next week. They want a shared POC environment + SSO + a pricing estimate for reserved capacity. Can we sync?
Ben T: copying Mimi & Aaron. What's the target SLA / latency? Partner expects <200ms p95 on small chat.
Mimi L: do they want Dedicated or Hosted? Dedicated can hit that but needs ~2 GPUs baseline. If Hosted, propose burst + prefix caching.
Shelly (NimbleCloud): They prefer Dedicated for data isolation. We'll send a security questionnaire today. Also want a short runbook for failover.
Aaron P: I'll draft an arch diagram + runbook. Key blockers to confirm: SAML SSO, VPC peering, customer-managed KMS, and EU data residency.
Ben T: can you confirm expected qps and avg token length? Need to size batching/kv cache.
Sara K: initial steady-state ~5 qps, expected spikes up to 30 qps. Typical prompt+response ~512-1024 tokens. Budget ask: partner wants a 30% channel discount on reserved commit.
Mimi L: rough reserved pricing for 2x A100-equivalent with autoscale to 4 => ~$24k/month ballpark. I'll run precise model (batching, quantization) and post numbers tomorrow.
Aaron P: Security Q from partner: support for customer-managed keys + audit logs? Answer: yes for Private; for Dedicated we can integrate customer KMS + full audit log forwarding. Will document specifics.
Shelly (NimbleCloud): they'll also need SOC2/TTP and pen-test summary before legal signs off. Is the SOC2 public link okay?
Mimi L: yes — we have a public SOC2 PDF. link: https://redwood.example.com/compliance/soc2.pdf
Ben T: Proposed POC infra snippet for ops team (VPC peering + security groups):
```hcl
resource "aws_vpc_peering_connection" "peer" {
  vpc_id        = "vpc-abc123"
  peer_vpc_id   = "vpc-nimble-456"
  auto_accept   = true
}
# Security group example
resource "aws_security_group" "redwood_inference" {
  name        = "rw-inference-poc"
  description = "Allow traffic from NimbleCloud peered VPC"
  ingress {
    from_port   = 443
    to_port     = 443
    protocol    = "tcp"
    cidr_blocks = ["10.2.0.0/16"]
  }
}
```
Sara K: nice. Ben — can you add a short test plan for latency/test prompts (10k sample prompts, spike test to 30 qps for 15m)?
Ben T: yep. I'll paste the test plan in the partner runbook and include an automated script.
Aaron P: scheduling: tech deep-dive Wed 10am PT. I'll invite NimbleCloud infra lead + our SRE.
Sara K: action items: Mimi — final cost model & SOC2 link; Aaron — arch diagram + runbook; Ben — infra snippet + test plan; Sara — pricing/contract note.
Mimi L: ack. will have cost sheet + a two-slide pricing summary by EOD tomorrow.
Oncall Bot: runbook doc created: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/partners/nimblecloud-poc (auto-created).
Sara K: thanks all. After the Wed call we'll finalize the go/no-go checklist and hand the assets to partner enablement repo.
Aaron P: I'll also append a short rollback procedure and fallback model (hosted smaller instance) to the runbook.
Shelly (NimbleCloud): appreciate it — we'll send the SAQ this afternoon and confirm Wed invite.
Sara K: great. If anything blocks, ping #eng-oncall. :thumbsup:
